information: The competition will be held for Fewest Moves and Square-1 on Sunday and for the rest of events on Saturday **in different, close venues**. Registration will be limited to 185 competitors. The registration fee is $3n + 14, where n is the number of events you compete in for Saturday, and $8 per event on Sunday.
